Feliz cumpleaños to Mollie Horwitz of Miami Beach who turns 106 today! 🎉 

#FL27 wishes you many more years of health and happiness! https://t.co/MsziAvT9cR

In honor of my late friend, @repdonyoung, I was proud to cosponsor the Don Young Vets Conservation Act. 

Through veteran grants at the NOAA, this bill will tackle two problems at once: the declining health of our oceans, & helping servicemembers readjust to civilian life.

Great schools ensure Miami’s best years lay ahead. 50 years ago, @FIU opened. They’re the US’s 72nd public school, the nation’s top producer of minority grads, and a recognized leader in environmental resilience, brain health, and defense tech. Congrats to the 58K Panthers!

I greatly appreciate Matthew Love and Dr. Marcos Mestre of Nicklaus Children’s Hospital meeting me on Capitol Hill to discuss how to address the heartbreaking mental health crisis facing so many children. 

We must ensure federal support reaches South FL health institutions! https://t.co/tvOpiAvOr0
To my Jewish constituents, I wish you a meaningful fast today on your most sacred day of Yom Kippur. May you be sealed in the Book of Life for health, happiness and success.

Team Salazar wishes all of #FL27 a very Merry Christmas!

Christians around the world gather with their loved ones and communities to celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ.

May today be a day of peace, reflection, and good health for all! https://t.co/t1z9WHyguh

On Wednesday, the House will vote to repeal all COVID-19 vaccine mandates for foreign air travelers to the U.S. It's a win for #Miami, the free state of Florida, and medical freedom! ☀️

Proud to support @RepThomasMassie's bill! #FL27

We cannot let the Biden Administration hurt Florida seniors. Proud to join @VernBuchanan & my colleagues in making it clear that protecting Medicare Advantage is beneficial for #FL27 seniors.
 
CMS must reverse its poorly constructed proposal to do just that… ¡Qué no te engañen! https://t.co/73htaK2fjv

Today, I introduced the Panama Canal Zone Veterans Act to give veterans who were exposed during their service to harmful herbicides the healthcare they deserve through the @DeptVetAffairs.

#FL27 https://t.co/5PlIcZFw4O

Strong immunization programs are a vital component of primary health care. U.S. investments in lifesaving vaccines are critical to reaching communities in need around the world!

#WorldImmunizationWeek #FL27

I am encouraged by the FDA's latest announcement regarding Leqembi. This is the 1st treatment that addresses ALZ progression. 

I’m proud to work with @alzsefl & my colleagues to support greater access to treatments for those living with Alzheimer's.

https://t.co/MwJ0YtQRO4

The White House is no longer going to track cocaine production in Colombia to appease the socialist President, Gustavo Petro.

We must put the health of Americans and Colombians over ideology.

https://t.co/3IuZ4Yx4tX
The Dignity Act (HR 3599) will help address our nation’s chronic nursing shortage and improve healthcare for all Americans! 🇺🇸🗽

I got to visit Vanessa Alfonso Lupiáñez, the brave 7-year-old Cuban girl my office helped get from Cuba to the US for the cancer treatment she needed!

Her family shared with me the amazing news that her cancer is now GONE!

Read more about it here 👇🏼
https://t.co/4lUhd2GMQ9

Happy New Year to you and yours in District 27! 🎉🎆

May 2024 bring you countless blessings and good health! 🙏🏼 https://t.co/2fxVVJNyMn

It’s always a pleasure to help my constituents with their casework needs!

Need help? Come to my Casework Fair!

WHEN: May 3, 10AM-2PM
WHERE: Coral Gables Library
WHO: Representatives from USCIS, Social Security, Medicare, and more!

Register here ⬇️
https://t.co/dyvdZxu3Yt https://t.co/BnmWy2RUJq

Happy to join @townofcutlerbay Mayor Tim Meerbott during National Health Center Week for a tour of one of our community health centers, with @CHISouthFl! 🏥🌴

We are working across all levels of government to provide quality healthcare to our residents, no matter their income! https://t.co/eGjBxmIdUT

Matt Gaetz has been one of most intelligent members in Congress.

We will miss his debates!

1. Dignity Act is not amnesty. It’s the opposite.

Amnesty is what we have now.
Illegals have
free roads,
free schools,
free hospitals.
No more.

4. The Dignity Act is good for America.
Why?

- It generates $45 billion to retrain American workers.
- It helps us compete with China.
- It secures U.S. food supply and empowers farmers.
- It brings in trillions in federal taxes to rescue Social Security/Medicare.

All Americans deserve life-saving care—especially those with rare diseases. I’m introducing the John W. Walsh Alpha-1 Home Infusion Act to ensure Alpha-1 patients get the treatment they need, at home.

https://t.co/0AGJRL8HtU

Cuba's communist regime has done nothing but lead its people into misery. It's time to finally end the regime's abuse of Cuban medical missions. 

https://t.co/hpvazM4aOo

The health of our communities depends on the well-being of our small businesses. 

That’s why I am co-sponsoring the Main Street Certainty Act to give them the tax relief they deserve.

The long nightmare has finally ended for @mariaCorinaYA’s team, who were under siege at the Argentine Embassy for over a year without electricity, water, and medicine. 

Congratulations @secrubio—the next step is saying chau to Maduro, Diosdado, and the rest of the mafia!

The Cuban regime’s so-called “medical missions” are nothing but modern-day slavery. Doctors are trafficked abroad, stripped of their rights, and forced to work while the regime pockets their pay.
Countries that participate in this scheme aren’t helping, they’re funding repression.

I support @SecRubio’s visa bans on officials who profit from this abuse. No nation should enrich a dictatorship by exploiting its own people.

It’s time to end these slave missions and stand with the Cuban people.

https://t.co/doSf6J9xnY
